### Unit-test agent

**`frontend/src/features/todos/utils/todos.ts`**: no tests added.

Is it intended that a task due today is now overdue? The description says it should count as overdue only after the day ends. Line 62 changed `<` to `<=`. A task due `2026-10-15` is now overdue at any time on 2026-10-15.

Existing tests already encode the described rule and fail on this head (5 failures):
- `isOverdue is not overdue on its due date` (3 times of day)
- `isOverdue handles month and year boundaries`
- `TodoItem details does not mark a task due today as overdue`

I left them unchanged. Restoring `<` should fix them.

**Impact:** `TodoItem.tsx:48-52` shows the warning badge and the overdue label all day for tasks due today.

items.message: No tests changed; the change contradicts the stated rule and existing tests already cover it. Reported in the PR comment.
